physical_reference: Original RAD NODE coordinates mapped by original NODE_ID; float64 archival and float32 model-input versions are both stored.
graph_definition: Six undirected corner edges per original TETRA10 element, duplicates removed and both directions stored. This is the ANIM/VTK linearized corner representation; original midside nodes are not model inputs.
solid_corner_topology: 109600 TETRA10 elements have four distinct ANIM corners. 20150 BRICK elements have eight distinct corners and 468 BRICK elements are valid six-corner degenerate wedge representations in eight slots.
element_average: TETRA10: equal-weight mean of valid integration points 111,112,121,211. BRICK Isolid=1: integration point111 only. Invalid zero integration-point outputs are excluded.
nodal_projection: Reference linearized-corner solid-volume weighted global strain tensor and EPSP; then Frobenius norm of projected strain tensor. Corner volumes are an explicit postprocessing approximation to the quadratic FEM geometry.
stress_target: Von Mises invariant of solver GPS_SIGXX/YY/ZZ/XY/ZY/XZ nodal stresses, matching the official Curator operation order. Different from cell Von Mises averaged at nodes.
